details: Hopes for a diplomatic resolution between the US and Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz have receded, leading to a significant rally in oil prices, with Brent crude approaching $90 a barrel. This geopolitical tension is reigniting fears of inflation globally and pushing bond yields higher, contributing to a cautious investor sentiment across financial markets, including a pullback in risk assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: US-Iran Standoff Escalates, Fueling Oil Price Rally and Inflation Concerns

details: The cryptocurrency market has experienced a broad downturn, with Bitcoin falling below $64,000 and Ethereum also recording losses. This market weakness is largely attributed to the persistent inflation concerns stemming from rising oil prices and heightened investor caution ahead of the critical US Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, scheduled for release on Wednesday. Institutional Bitcoin ETF flows have also turned negative, indicating a decrease in buying interest.
title: Crypto Market Dips as Investors Await US Inflation Data

details: The U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) has announced sanctions against digital asset exchanges alleged to be used by the Iranian regime to launder billions of dollars and finance groups like the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). The action targets two major digital asset exchanges, Shelbit Exchange and Aban Tether, and a network of front companies involved in facilitating illicit cryptocurrency activities and sanctions evasion.
title: US Treasury Sanctions Crypto Exchanges Funding Iranian Illicit Activities
